title: Approve the homepage composition
question: Three compositions of Your business, in miniature. Each tests a different hook. Pick the one to build; use the steer box to combine (e.g. comp 3's layout with comp 2's headline) or to name anything that feels false. Other hook candidates: “You shouldn’t have to be the system.” · “Room to grow. No new coordinator required.” Invented signage and slogans inside the renders will not ship.

options.label: Split: pitch beside the business
options.thesis: Better work, faster. Without another hire. — the outcome leads, the miniature proves the problem beside it.
options.viewport: Headline and booking left; the cutaway business right with every packet converging on the owner's desk.
options.risk: The most familiar hero arrangement; the miniature reads as a picture beside the pitch until motion starts.

options.label: Panorama: the whole business as a stage
options.thesis: Your business runs on you. It shouldn't have to. — centered hook over a full-width cross-section with the owner at center.
options.viewport: Centered hook and button up top; the business spans edge to edge beneath, owner's office dead center.
options.risk: On a 1366×768 laptop most of the building sits below the fold, so the story lands on the first scroll.

options.label: Before / after: drag the fix across
options.thesis: Why does everything come back to you? — the visitor drags from Today to After the fix and watches the tangle straighten.
options.viewport: Diorama left split by a yellow drag handle, Today vs After the fix; hook and booking right.
options.risk: Shows the whole transformation up front, spending the scroll reveal; the drag has to be obvious on touch.
